final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT L.ID AS id, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(L.ALB) AS alb, AVG(CAST(L.UN AS REAL) / L."T-BIL") AS r FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX <> '' GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT sex, AVG(alb) AS a, AVG(r) AS r FROM s1 GROUP BY sex), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s2) SELECT s2.sex, s2.a, s2.r, s2.a - s3.m FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.a > s3.m
